hits.title: Basket Random
hits.description:
Basket Random is a chaotic arcade basketball game where every match turns into a funny test of timing, luck, and unpredictable physics. Instead of giving players a serious sports simulation, it focuses on quick rounds, simple controls, and hilarious ragdoll movement. You control your team with one key, jump toward the ball, block your opponent, and try to score before the other side reaches the winning point. The idea is easy to understand, but the random physics make every attempt feel different.

What makes Basket Random stand out is the way it changes after almost every score. One round may take place on a normal court, while the next may throw you into a completely different setup with unusual players, strange body proportions, or a ball that behaves in an unexpected way. Sometimes the characters have long arms, sometimes their movement feels heavier, and sometimes the ball bounces in a way that makes even a simple shot difficult to predict. This constant variety keeps the game fresh without making it complicated.

The controls are intentionally simple, which makes the game accessible for almost anyone. In single-player mode, you can play against the CPU and practice your timing. In 2-player mode, the game becomes even more entertaining because both players share the same device and compete in fast, messy basketball duels. Since both sides are dealing with the same strange physics, every point feels like a mix of skill, reaction, and comedy.

Basket Random is especially enjoyable for players who like short sports games with instant action. You do not need to learn complex moves, manage a team, or follow advanced basketball rules. The goal is clear: jump, reach the ball, defend your basket, and score. However, the challenge comes from reading the movement of your characters and adapting quickly when the game changes the court, the players, or the ball behavior.

The pixel-style visuals give the game a clean and playful look, while the ragdoll animation creates many unexpected moments. A missed jump can turn into a lucky block. A bad shot can bounce into the basket. A perfect attack can fail because your player lands in the wrong position. These small surprises are the reason Basket Random feels fun even after many rounds.

For fans of funny basketball games, local 2-player games, and physics-based sports challenges, Basket Random offers a simple but highly replayable experience. It is easy to start, fast to understand, and unpredictable enough to keep every match exciting. Whether you are playing alone or challenging a friend, each round brings a new chance to score a ridiculous basket, make a surprising comeback, or laugh at a completely unexpected play.

Jump, block, and shoot with one key. Time your moves well and score before your opponent.

hits.title: Basketball Rush
hits.description:
You have two minutes. A ball appears somewhere on the court, you drag to set the top of its arc and let go. A new ball is waiting as soon as the last one leaves your hand.

A make is worth the length of the shot, measured to the centimetre, times your multiplier. A clean swish adds 1 to it, a bank shot adds 0.5, and every make in a row adds another 1, up to ×10. One miss and the streak is gone. A shot released before 0:00 that drops after the buzzer gets 5 extra points.

The ball flies in 3D and spins. The rim gives a little when it's hit, so a shot that clips the iron can still roll in, or rattle out.

Ranked games go on the global leaderboard and count toward your league, and you can be relegated from a league too. Practice has no clock and counts for nothing, so that's the place to learn the long ones.
hits.howToPlayText:
Score as many points as you can before the two minutes run out.

Mouse or touch: press anywhere on the screen and drag. The circle is the highest point the ball will reach, and the dotted line shows how it gets there. Let go to shoot. If you let go without dragging, the throw is cancelled.

Keyboard: the arrow keys move the circle, Space shoots.

Longer shots score more. Clean swishes, bank shots and makes in a row raise your multiplier, and a miss resets the streak. P or Esc pauses the game. On a phone, play in landscape.

hits.title: Basket Sport Stars
hits.description:
Basket Sport Stars brings fast, playful basketball matches to colorful courts filled with unpredictable moments. Choose a character, challenge a computer-controlled rival, or share the keyboard with a friend in local 2-player mode. Move into position, time your jump, aim carefully, and score as many baskets as possible before the final buzzer.

Every match is short enough to start quickly but competitive enough to demand focus. A well-timed shot can put you ahead, while a successful attack may force your opponent to lose possession. With different characters, changing arenas, several game modes, and useful power-ups, no two matches feel exactly the same.

Choose Your Game Mode
Quick Match sends you straight into a 90-second basketball battle. The player with the most points when time runs out wins. It is the best mode for learning the basics or enjoying a fast match without a longer commitment.

Tournament Mode places you into a competitive bracket against several opponents. Win each round, adapt to different characters and courts, and continue advancing until you reach the final match.

Practice Mode gives you room to learn movement, shooting, and attack timing. Use it to test jump shots, understand the aiming guide, and become more comfortable with the controls before entering harder matches.

2 Player Mode lets two players compete locally on the same keyboard. Challenge a friend, fight for possession, and find out who can score more baskets before the buzzer.

Master the Shooting System
Jump to reach the ball, then hold the shooting control to aim toward the opposing basket. A dotted trajectory line shows where the ball is expected to travel. Watch the line closely and release at the right moment for a more accurate attempt.

The aiming indicator briefly turns green when the shot has a strong chance of reaching the hoop. This window does not stay open for long, so successful shooting depends on quick reactions and controlled timing rather than pressing the button as fast as possible.

Attack and Take Possession
Basketball is not only about shooting. When your opponent controls the ball, move close and use the attack button to weaken their grip. After enough successful hits, the rival drops the ball and gives you a chance to take possession.

Attacking without a plan can leave your basket unprotected. Try to pressure the opponent when they are preparing a shot or moving into a dangerous position, then return quickly before they recover.

Collect and Use Gift Boxes
A flying gift box may appear during a match. Jump to collect it and save the reward for the right opportunity. Activating the gift launches a rocket across the court that can stun the opposing player and interrupt their attack.

The rocket can also become a threat when your rival uses one. Watch its direction and jump over it to avoid being stunned. A well-timed gift can change the score, especially during the final seconds of a close match.

Key Features
- Fast arcade-style basketball matches
- Single-player and local 2-player gameplay
- Quick Match, Tournament, Practice, and 2 Player modes
- Competitive 90-second rounds
- Different characters and colorful basketball courts
- Timing-based aiming and shooting system
- Attacks that can force opponents to drop the ball
- Gift boxes with special rocket power-ups
- Simple keyboard controls for both players
- Short matches designed for repeated play

Tips for Beginners
- Start in Practice Mode to learn how long to hold the shooting button.
- Release the ball when the aiming guide gives you a clear trajectory.
- Stay between your opponent and the basket when defending.
- Do not attack constantly; wait until you are close enough to connect.
- Collect gift boxes whenever the court is safe.
- Keep watching the timer during close matches.

Advanced Tips
- Use short jumps to control possession instead of always attempting a shot.
- Attack just before the opponent releases the ball to disrupt their timing.
- Save a rocket gift for a dangerous attack or the final seconds of the match.
- Change your shooting position so the opponent cannot predict every attempt.
- After stealing the ball, create space before aiming at the basket.
- In tournaments, adjust your strategy to each opponent instead of repeating the same moves.

Common Mistakes
- Releasing every shot before the aiming line is properly aligned.
- Standing too close to the opponent while trying to aim.
- Ignoring defense after taking an early lead.
- Using gift rewards immediately without checking the rival's position.
- Chasing the ball and leaving the basket completely open.
- Forgetting that the match can be decided in the final few seconds.

Become the Court Star
Basket Sport Stars combines accessible controls with quick competitive matches, accurate shooting, defensive attacks, and unexpected power-ups. Practice your timing, choose the right moment to challenge your opponent, and work your way through the tournament. Whether you compete against the CPU or face a friend on the same keyboard, every match offers another chance to become the star of the court.

hits.title: Flippee Ball
hits.description:
A HYBRID ARCADE GAME OF PINBALL & BASKETBALL

-Flip the flippers and try to hit the ball into the basket.  
-Play against the CPU or another player on the same device.  
-Perfect your technique in the Academy - 100 increasingly challenging "assists" for you to try to score from.
hits.howToPlayText:
You control one set of flippers - either red or blue.  Flipping uses just one button and flips all five of your flippers.  See if you have what it takes to beat the computer.  The default settings are "AMATEUR" speed against the computer on "EASY" difficulty with "AIM ASSIST" enabled (this gives you a little help with shot accuracy).  Once you feel comfortable, try the other difficulties, "PROFFESSIONAL" speed, then switch "AIM ASSIST" off!

If that's not enough, try the "FLIPPEE ACADEMY" - 100 levels (50 each at "AMATEUR" & "PROFESSIONAL" speeds) where the ball is launched and you must try to score - but each level only allows for a certain number of touches - and you must score before the ball hits your opponent's flippers.

Navigate menus using:
- Mouse
- Touch
- Keyboard (arrow keys and space to action)
- Controller - direction pad and any of the main four buttons

Use the game mode button to the left of the scoreboard to select between 7 game modes:

- Longest Streak - see how many games in a row you can win against the computer:
  - Easy
  - Medium
  - Hard
  - Progressive (difficulty increases with every game)
- Career - difficulty increases with every game, but losing doesn't reset progress
- Player v Player - play against another human on the same device
- Academy - 100 "assists" for you to try to score from 

To flip:

Single player:
- Mouse - click the screen
- Touch - tap the screen
- Keyboard - LEFT CTRL
- Controller - any of the four main buttons

Player vs Player:
- Mouse - click the top left or top right of the screen to control either the left or right flippers
- Touch - tap the top left or top right of the screen
- Keyboard - LEFT CTRL (left flipper) & RIGHT ARROW (right flippers)
- Controller - any of the four main buttons (supports 2 controllers for player v player)

To pause:

- Mouse - click the scoreboard
- Touch - tap the scoreboard
- Keyboard - Press "P"
- Controller - "Start" button

To win:

SCORE MORE THAN YOUR OPPONENT!

Change the game speed from "AMATEUR" to "PROFESSIONAL" and disable "AIM ASSIST" (if you're up for a challeng!) in the SETTINGS menu.
A quick start guide is shown when the game is first run and full instructions can be found in the built-in help guide.

hits.title: Precise Shooting
hits.description: Test your aim and precision in Precise Shooting, a satisfying basketball shooting challenge! Launch the ball with perfect timing and angle to score into the hoop from various tricky positions and distances. The core idea is mastering trajectory and power — one well-timed shot can earn you massive points and combos. What makes it unique? Beautiful minimalist 3D visuals, realistic ball physics with satisfying arcs, increasing difficulty with moving hoops and obstacles, and the addictive “one more try” feeling as you chase perfect shots and high scores!
hits.howToPlayText:
Your main goal is to shoot the basketball into the hoop with perfect precision. Hold and drag to adjust the power and angle, then release at the right moment to make the shot. Score as many points as possible by making clean shots — the better your timing and angle, the higher your score!

PC Controls:
Mouse: Click and hold on the player, drag to set power and angle, then release to shoot.

Mobile Controls:
Touchscreen: Tap and hold on the player, drag to adjust shooting power and angle, then release to shoot the ball.

hits.title: On Fire Basketball Shots
hits.description:
The gym is packed, and the crowd is roaring! The scoreboard's ticking down, and your team is trailing. The only way to win is to sink blazing basketball shots from the court. You're the star player, but the pressure's on—every shot counts, and the hoop's rim is red-hot, making each attempt trickier!
"Core: A highly engaging, physics-based arcade sports simulator centered on precision shooting and high-score chasing.
Loop: Players engage in skill-based shooting mechanics to accumulate points, which convert into hard currency (coins) used for continuous progression and reward loops.
Start: Features instant, intuitive accessibility, ensuring immediate player engagement and a strong hook from the first session.
Playgama Fact: The game is fully integrated with Playgama SDK: instant login and cross-device saves between PC and mobile. HTML5. Stable performance regardless of internet quality.
Visual: Utilizes a clean, contemporary Flat Design aesthetic that ensures visual clarity and broad appeal.
Key Feature: Offers deep player customization through various unlockable ball and environment skins, underpinned by robust, authentic shot physics."
hits.howToPlayText:
Ignite the Hoops and Go On Fire! The crowd is roaring as you chain blazing basketball shots from hoop to sizzling hoop in this addictive arcade thriller. Pull back to launch perfect dunks, build unstoppable streaks, set the ball ablaze for massive multipliers, collect coins and stars, and climb the leaderboards with sky-high scores—every swish counts in this red-hot test of precision and timing!
Main Objective and Winning Method:
The primary goal is to score as many points as possible by chaining consecutive successful basketball shots into moving hoops without missing. Each dunk adds to your score (with perfect swishes earning bonuses), builds your streak, and unlocks 'On Fire' mode for double points and fiery visual effects. The game ends when you miss a shot—survive longer, chain more dunks, and rack up the highest score to top the global leaderboards and earn coins for upgrades!
Desktop Controls (via emulator or browser):
Mouse: Click and hold on the basketball, drag downward to aim and set power (watch the trajectory guide), release to shoot.
Mobile Controls:
Touch Screen: Tap and hold on the basketball hanging in the net, drag your finger downward to adjust aim and strength, then release to launch the shot toward the next hoop.
